reader_summary.overview: Charles Duhigg is a celebrated writer for The New Yorker and author of bestseller "The Power of Habit." His latest book. Our conversation covers Charles' path to writing business stories and personal books and turn to his latest tour du force. We discuss the science behind connection, three types of conversations, methods to become a better communicator, and tools to navigate challenging conversations.

key_points.text: Charles Duhigg is a celebrated writer for The New Yorker and author of bestseller "The Power of Habit." His latest book.
Charles' book and words feel like unlocking a secret language that can help anyone connect better with others.
